coverageGaps: The Tick root is a canonical physical generic entry, not a runtime closed Center proof. Retain only explicit same-thread paired enclosure and pointer joins.
Scoped generic descendants use exact reviewed direct call sites. OnEnter remains an independently observed virtual-dispatch candidate; no invented direct Transit-to-OnEnter callsite.
MethodInfo reads cover only code pair bytes 0..15 and token/flags bytes 72..84 inclusive. No alternate-code slot or initialized lifetime is inferred.
No async ownership, complete writer census, replacement-original selection, actual sorted priority order or input automation.

Input/cache, Center storage, Skill/Ability lifetime, action environment and modifier/HP observations share one recording. Command Execute is omitted because the downstream OnExecute boundary suffices; no damage operand/context hooks are selected. Local stored HP and ApplyResult do not establish server acknowledgement, virtual HP accessor selection or async causal ownership.

Dilation OnTick/Stop and Skill interrupt marker/predicates retain selected timing values; predicates are scoped to paired ancestry. The dilation owner getter is not selected, so object-to-owner identity, curve output and continuous clock delivery remain unresolved. Global PeriodicTimer.Update and AbilitySystem.PreLateTick are omitted to bound traffic.
